Hi Janelle — thanks for the clear note and the invoice. We can absolutely do split invoices and route remittance per entity; brief outline and ask below so we can generate the correct docs and bank instructions: 

1) Template: I'll send a simple CSV template that we ask you to return with row-level allocation (entity, cost_center, percent, PO).
2) VAT handling: For UK/DE entities, Redwood needs to know if Albedo will self-assess (reverse charge) or if you need Redwood to apply VAT. Please confirm which approach you expect; for vendor-side VAT we will produce separate invoice numbers per legal entity and include VAT lines.
3) Rounding/prorata: we will compute per-line prorated amounts and round to cents; any tiny residuals will be assigned to a designated entity you choose (tell us which).
4) Bank / payment instructions: we can provide separate remittance details per legal entity; for wire instructions we will include beneficiary name and bank reference. For ACH we will include our US entity details only.
